title: grpc: simplify invoke() by sharing code with streaming RPCs
body:
This PR is part of a multi-PR change aimed to support call options like Header, Trailer etc where the result can be mutated by an xDS HTTP filter.

This PR specifically does the following:
- Gets rid of the `defaultStreamInterceptor` function and stops chaining a default interceptor to all streaming RPCs
- Instead it creates a `clientStreamWrapper` from `newClientStream` and thereby ensures that this functionality can be shared between unary and streaming RPCs
- Simplifies the implementation of `invoke()` in call.go

No tests are being added since no new functionality is being added and this is simply a refactor.

In the following PR, I will add functionality to change the `after` method in the `CallOption` interface to work with `ClientStream` instead of `csAttempt`.

RELEASE NOTES: none
